name: smwgraphics-mario-is-missing-nes-london-england
title: Mario is Missing! (NES) - London, England
description:
The tileset used in London England of Mario is Missing! for the NES.

Notes:
Pipes are Exit-Enabled, like in the original game.
Includes 2 sample levels, the top street and bottom street, which showcases almost everything from the tileset.
